newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, heavy spreading seen.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, heavy spreading seen.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed and consolidated amid heavy spread activity between the December and March contracts, traders said.
"This was consolidation-type trade," a trader said. "Our cash market is still firm, and I think the spread activity will keep up as long as (cash premiums) stay that way."
Traders said the spread activity also reflected Monday's close, in which the nearby Dec gained over deferreds.
"The locals sold off March, May and July at the close yesterday and ran up the December, so I think we're just seeing the spread come back into line," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat closed three cents per bushel lower to 3/4 cent higher, with Dec down 1-1/2 cents at $4.22-1/4. March gained 3/4 cents to close at $4.12.
Traders said Atwood-Peavey bull-spread one million Dec/March bushels and bought 500,000 Dec. Benson-Quinn bought one million Dec. Wilson bought 1.5 million and 500,000 Dec and sold 800,000 March.
The MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat futures volume at 21.537 million bushels, versus 19.159 million Monday.
MGE barley closed three to five cents per cwt lower, with Dec down five cents at $6.93.
